title: 14 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj in London: Morning puja darshan and sabha at Islington Mandir
story: Morning puja darshan and sabha at Islington Mandir. Padhramani at offices of Garavi Gujarat publication. Day 2 of Bal-Yuva Adhiveshan and evening sabha at Friends Hall, Euston.
